definition: Identifier assigned to a building record during dataset processing
notes: Unique within this dataset; not an OSM identifier

definition: OpenStreetMap element type used for the feature
notes: Examples may include way or relation

definition: OpenStreetMap element identifier
notes: Use together with osm_element when resolving the source object

definition: Latitude of the building representative point
notes: WGS 84 geographic coordinates

definition: Longitude of the building representative point
notes: WGS 84 geographic coordinates

definition: Planar area calculated from the mapped OSM building footprint; used as a roof-area proxy
notes: Not a direct measurement of usable roof surface; footprint geometry and mapping quality affect the value

definition: OpenStreetMap building tag or mapped building classification
notes: Generic values such as 'yes' indicate a building without a more specific type

definition: Number of building levels where provided by OSM
notes: Sparse OSM metadata; numeric conversion may turn malformed values into missing values

definition: Building height where provided by OSM
notes: Sparse OSM metadata; not inferred for buildings without a value

definition: Roof shape tag where provided by OSM
notes: Highly incomplete optional metadata

definition: Roof orientation value where provided by OSM
notes: All values are missing in the current dataset; do not interpret as zero or north-facing

definition: Footprint-area review flag
notes: Current rule: 'large_building' when roof_area_m2 > 5000; otherwise 'normal'. Large footprints are retained, not automatically considered erroneous

definition: SRTM-derived elevation sampled at the building representative point
notes: Terrain/context feature; not roof elevation

definition: SRTM-derived terrain slope sampled at the building representative point
notes: Terrain slope, not roof pitch

definition: SRTM-derived terrain aspect sampled at the building representative point
notes: Terrain aspect, not roof orientation; circular variable

definition: 2025 Sentinel-2 annual-composite NDVI sampled at the building representative point
notes: Pixel may represent nearby vegetation, pavement, shadow, or another surface rather than the roof itself

definition: NASA POWER climatological average daily global horizontal irradiance at the Pune reference coordinate
notes: Single representative city-level value repeated for every building; not a building-specific measurement

definition: NASA POWER climatological average daily direct normal irradiance at the Pune reference coordinate
notes: Single representative city-level value repeated for every building

definition: NASA POWER climatological air temperature at the Pune reference coordinate
notes: Single representative city-level value repeated for every building

definition: NASA POWER climatological relative humidity at the Pune reference coordinate
notes: Single representative city-level value repeated for every building

definition: NASA POWER climatological wind speed at the Pune reference coordinate
notes: Single representative city-level value repeated for every building

definition: Human-readable study-area label
notes: Current value: Pune, Maharashtra, India

definition: Calendar year represented by the Sentinel-2 NDVI composite
notes: Current value: 2025
